guides.definition: Runs PSScriptAnalyzer recursively and limits results to the selected severities. Requires PSScriptAnalyzer in the active PowerShell environment; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Quoted file or directory path to analyze.

examples.title: Analyze the current source tree
examples.explanation: Recursive analysis applies the installed rules to every supported PowerShell file under the path.

guides.definition: Checks a script definition without writing it to disk and selects named rules. Requires PSScriptAnalyzer in the active PowerShell environment; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: Rule name or comma-separated rule names.

examples.title: Check an unsafe credential parameter
examples.explanation: ScriptDefinition is useful for generated snippets and tests; IncludeRule keeps the result focused.

guides.definition: Captures PSScriptAnalyzer findings and displays the most useful review columns. Requires PSScriptAnalyzer in the active PowerShell environment; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Quoted script or module path to analyze.

examples.title: Review one module
examples.code:
$results = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path '.\Module.psm1'
$results | Format-Table RuleName, Severity, Line, Message -AutoSize
examples.explanation: Capturing results keeps them available for filtering, export, or build-gate logic after the table view.
